trello.name: Set up Stripe subscription tiers
trello.desc: Create three subscription tiers in Stripe: Basic ($29/month with basic AI model selection tool access and limited features), Pro ($49/month with additional features and priority support), and Enterprise ($99/month with all features, custom support, and integration options). Ensure tiers are correctly reflected in the app in terms of functionality and user experience. Owner: Alex. Deadline: within next two weeks (initial integration).

trello.name: Build Stripe Elements checkout form
trello.desc: Implement the checkout process using Stripe Elements. Ensure the checkout form matches the app's design with a clean, straightforward layout. Include a clear feature comparison for each tier, a prominent checkout button, and a tooltip or help icon explaining what happens if the user chooses a different plan later. Handle potential errors gracefully (invalid card details, insufficient funds). Owner: Jordan. Deadline: within next two weeks (initial integration).

trello.name: Update pricing page for subscription tiers
trello.desc: Update the existing pricing page to reflect the new subscription tiers (Basic, Pro, Enterprise) with their respective prices and feature sets. Ensure users can easily understand what they get with each plan. Owner: Jordan. Deadline: within next two weeks (initial integration).

trello.name: Build user dashboard for subscription management
trello.desc: Create a user dashboard that provides: current plan details and billing info; options to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscription; access to invoices and payment history; ability to update payment methods. Dashboard should be intuitive, reflect current subscription status in real-time, and notify users of changes (successful plan upgrades, payment failures). Owner: Jordan. Deadline: within next two weeks (initial integration).

trello.name: Integrate Stripe API for subscription management
trello.desc: Integrate Stripe's API on the backend to handle all subscription-related tasks including: creating subscriptions when a user selects a plan and completes payment; processing successful and failed payments; managing webhooks for events like invoice payment success/failure and subscription cancellations. Owner: Taylor. Deadline: within next two weeks (initial integration).

trello.name: Set up and test Stripe webhook handlers
trello.desc: Set up webhook handlers for the following events: invoice.payment_succeeded (confirm successful payments and activate/continue subscription), invoice.payment_failed (notify users of failed payments, prompt to update payment info, consider sending email notification), customer.subscription.deleted (manage cancellations, update access rights, offer re-subscription). Create test scenarios to simulate different events like payment failures and cancellations. Thoroughly test all handlers. Owner: Taylor. Deadline: within next two weeks (initial integration), with testing in the following week.

trello.name: Integrate frontend with backend API
trello.desc: Once the backend is set up, integrate the frontend components with the API. Ensure any changes to the subscription are reflected in real-time on the dashboard. Handle errors during integration and provide clear notifications to users (e.g., if a payment fails, clearly inform the user and provide instructions on how to fix it). Owner: Jordan. Deadline: within next two weeks (initial integration), with testing in the following week.

trello.name: Prepare detailed test plan for subscription flow
trello.desc: Prepare a detailed test plan covering both manual and automated tests. Include testing the whole subscription flow from sign-up to billing to managing the subscription. Cover all edge cases and ensure everything functions as expected. Share the test plan with the team. Owner: Taylor. Deadline: testing phase (third week).

trello.name: Implement user notifications for subscription events
trello.desc: Handle user notifications for different subscription events such as subscription confirmations and payment errors. Ensure clear, actionable notifications are provided to users when issues arise. Owner: Jordan. Deadline: within next two weeks (initial integration).

trello.name: Create user documentation and help section for subscriptions
trello.desc: Create clear user instructions on how to manage subscriptions, access invoices, and handle issues. Include a help section or FAQ covering common issues and questions about subscriptions. Make available once everything is live. Owner: Jordan (and team). Deadline: after initial integration and testing.

trello.name: Document API endpoints and webhook event handlers
trello.desc: Document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers to make future maintenance and troubleshooting easier. Owner: Taylor. Deadline: after initial integration.

trello.name: Schedule follow-up meeting for progress review
trello.desc: Set up a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress on the Stripe subscription integration and address any issues or blockers that come up. Owner: Alex. Deadline: next week.
